Preliminaries

Set Options

Code 
options(warning = FALSE)    # Don't show warnings

Install or Load packages

Code 
library(pacman)

# Load and if not found in the library will attempt to install the package
pacman::p_load(here,
               sf,
               readr,
               tmap,
               dplyr,
               ggplot2,
               tidyr,
               SimilarityMeasures,
               lubridate,
               plotly,
               terra, 
               tmap,
               install = TRUE)

Store relevant CRS

Code 
crs_lv03  <- 21781
crs_lv95  <- 2056
crs_wgs84 <- 4326

Task 1: Import and visualize spatial data

Boar

Code 
wildschwein_BE <- read_delim("data/wildschwein_BE_2056.csv", ",") |>
    st_as_sf(coords = c("E", "N"), crs = 2056, remove = FALSE)

Import

Code 
fanel <- read_sf("data/Feldaufnahmen_Fanel.gpkg")

Frucht = Character

Task 2: Annotate Trajectories from vector data

Code 
wildschwein_summer <- wildschwein_BE |>
  filter(
    (DatetimeUTC >= "2014-05-01" & DatetimeUTC < "2014-06-30") |
    (DatetimeUTC >= "2015-05-01" & DatetimeUTC < "2015-06-30")
  )
Code 
# join the two datasets
wildschwein_summer <- st_join(wildschwein_summer, fanel)

# visualisation
ggplot(fanel) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Frucht)) +
  geom_sf(data = wildschwein_summer)

Task 3: Explore annotated trajectories

Code 
# this code chunk was based on Javier Fellers solution since I struggled with a nice idea

summary_df <- wildschwein_summer |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(DatetimeUTC, TierName, Frucht) |>
  summarize(n=n(), .groups ="drop")

ggplot(summary_df,
       aes(x = DatetimeUTC, y = Frucht, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile() +
  
  facet_wrap(~ TierName) +
  
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#fff5eb",
    high = "#cc4c02") +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  
  labs(
    title = "Animal presence in Crop Types in May-June of 2014 and 2015",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Crop type"
  )

Task 4: Import and visualize vegetationindex (raster data)

Code 
vegetation_index <- terra::rast("data/vegetationshoehe_LFI.tif")

Plot

Code 
# using simple plot
plot(vegetation_index)

Tmap

Code 
# using tmap
tm_shape(vegetation_index) +
  tm_raster(palette = "viridis")

Task 5: Annotate Trajectories from raster data

Code 
# x = spatial raster, y = spatial vector (points, lines, polygons, df or matrix)
vegetation_index_df <- terra::extract(x = vegetation_index, y =  wildschwein_BE)

wildschwein_BE <- cbind(wildschwein_BE, vegetation_index_df)
